diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because check C1 passes in every rollout despite being linked to no decisive facts, suggesting it is a trivial or default check that does not depend on any hidden information. The model consistently selects baseline values (e.g., max_nodes: 12, scale_out_threshold_percent: 75) which match the public state rather than the hidden requirements in PF1.
